description: Read or write the system clipboard (text). Activates the tab and focuses its window first. write overwrites whatever the user had copied, which is not recoverable. To fill a field use type_text instead of write and paste; read checks what a Copy button copied, and an empty clipboard returns text "".

action.description: write takes text; read returns the current clipboard contents

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

name: clipboard
